chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from one of his companions, from Muhammad ibn Khalid Al-Tayalisi, from Ali ibn Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who wears trousers whilst seated would not get groin pain.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to put on trousers to avoid groin pain according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the physical act of dressing with bodily health, noting that donning trousers while seated prevents groin pain (khassirah), a condition often associated with strain or cold. This reflects the broader Shia tradition of integrating practical daily habits with spiritual and physical well-being, emphasizing mindfulness in mundane actions. The advice underscores the holistic view of the body in Islamic jurisprudence, where simple behavioral adjustments yield tangible health benefits.
